## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Conflicting confirmations: VXX (1W: -1.34% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: +0.41% | 1M: +1.15% / LQD 1W: +0.44% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND but HYG_LQD ratio signaling CREDIT STRESS ↓ (rising) — SPY/TLT flat (SPY 1W: +1.60% | 1M: +1.92% / TLT 1W: +1.03% | 1M: +0.34%) confirms mixed impulses.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear is receding via VXX (1W: -1.34% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND while credit conditions show strain per HYG_LQD ratio despite HYG (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND. Broad sector advance (10/11) and strong small-cap internals (IWM 1W: +4.60% | 1M: +3.86%) ABOVE TREND keep equity risk alive.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-cautious: Stocks vs Bonds flat but ABOVE TREND (SPY/TLT 1W: +0.38% | 1M: +1.29%) while TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND signals bond demand; Dollar strength rising (Level 27.33, 1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND keeps policy sensitivity elevated.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals/materials leading: XLB (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +8.71% | 1M: +17.67%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND; Tech is in RECOVERY with XLK (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -1.11%) RECOVERY — style: cyclicals/value showing more consistent strength than momentum tech.

5. US vs Global?  
US equities remain firm: SPY (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND and outperformance vs China where FXI (1W: -1.18% | 1M: +2.47%) is in CORRECTION. EM overall improving via EEM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND but China tech/internal weakness warrants monitoring.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Risk-on internals show healthy retail/speculative flow: IWM (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +3.86%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.53% | 1M: -2.71%) RECOVERY. Crypto exposure mixed with IBIT (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -3.20%) RECOVERY and Speculation Index falling (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -4.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Base/industrial metals and precious metals are strong: CPER (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +10.72%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +10.08% | 1M: +31.19%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — commodity-led reflation signals mixed with CPER_GLD deflation tilt flagged lower.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy is constructive: BNO (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +2.37%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: -13.76% | 1M: -26.24%) BELOW TREND remains a clear downside outlier.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector advance (10/11) and key risk proxies SPY (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +3.86%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -1.11%) versus broader strength is a short-term momentum risk to watch.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/materials/energy exposure given XLB (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +8.71% | 1M: +17.67%) ABOVE TREND; monitor credit stress signals (HYG/LQD) and reduce exposure to weak natural gas (UNG 1W: -13.76% | 1M: -26.24%) BELOW TREND. Bonds (TLT 1W: +1.03% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND remain a hedge but SPY/TLT flat suggests limited directional edge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials XAR (1W: +10.48% | 1M: +19.74%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +0.18%) CORRECTION and Tech momentum if XLK (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -1.11%) fails to extend.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +10.08% | 1M: +31.19%) ABOVE TREND and Copper/Industrial CPER (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +10.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -13.76% | 1M: -26.24%) BELOW TREND and agricultural pockets showing short-term RECOVERY signals (SOYB 1W: +1.42% | 1M: -2.64%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX (1W: -1.34% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency; HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: +0.41% | 1M: +1.15% / LQD 1W: +0.44% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND — watch HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 for credit stress; XLK vs XLF Tech/Financial spread (Level 2.6225, 1W: +1.78% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY is the style pivot to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, but mixed signals from credit and volatility. Cyclicals/materials/energy and small caps showing strength while Tech is in RECOVERY; monitor HYG_LQD credit signal and XLK momentum as key divergences.
